Export, import, or a shared folder on this device

Errata is published by Ordinary Tools. Your upkeep list stays on this device. There is no Errata account and no Ordinary Tools servers. Linking Google is optional. Contact: ordinary.tools.apps@gmail.com

Tasks, completion history, and settings live in the app’s local database. Settings include appearance, default reminder kind and time, digest, cadence, work-start, and how long to keep completion history. History can be trimmed or cleared in Settings. If you choose a backup folder, that folder’s address is remembered on this device only (it is not inside the exported JSON). If you link Google, a copy also lives in your Drive app folder.

No ads, analytics, or crash reporters. There is no Errata server. If you link Google, task titles, notes, and history are sent to Google Drive app data over HTTPS. Unlink stops that. Uninstall does not delete the Drive copy unless you choose to delete it in Settings.

resources.string: Export, import, and folder write/read are things you start. Import replaces all data here after you confirm. If Google is linked, import then uploads so the Drive copy follows this device. Optional Google link stores a hidden app file in your Drive — not a file you pick in the sheet.
Android cloud backup of Errata data is off. Move to another phone or tablet with Backup export or the folder file. Reminders are local. Errata is not a medical device.
